Overview

The AeroLink PX is a digital video transmitter designed for professional and industrial projects: live 1080p video at 60 fps, rugged MMCX antenna connectors and an SBUS input for integration into inspection, security and surveillance platforms.

It is the link platform for the PX version of the ThermaView 960 thermal camera.

Key features

1080p at 60 fpsSmooth live imaging.
35 msAverage latency.
5.650–5.924 GHz5.8 GHz band, 3 channels.
MMCX connectorsDual antenna, rugged connection.
SBUS + UARTPlatform integration.
3S to 6S11.1–25.2 V input.
